# testdata/large

Synthetic phone photos of shingled columns, generated by `tools/synthgen` (tools/synthgen v1).
Only `manifest.json` is committed; the JPEGs contain Wizards of the Coast card art
(images from Scryfall) and are regenerated locally:

```
uv run --project tools tools/synthgen/gen.py --set large --regen
```

That downloads the card images once into `testdata/cache/` (gitignored) and
rebuilds every image bit-for-bit from the per-image seeds in the manifest (same
machine and pinned library versions). The set was created with
`gen.py --set large --n 272 --seed 3` (card pool v2).

Contents: 272 images (181 C4, 91 C6;
68 easy, 68 hard, 136 normal), 24496 true card slots
(en 17341 (71%), other 972 (4%), pt 6183 (25%));
6344 distinct printings, 5624 distinct oracle_ids.
46 images with stop cards (partial columns), 14 retake images (a marker
hidden), 14 images with a 19-card column without stop card (column must be `error`).

Score a reader with:

```
uv run --project tools tools/eval.py --manifest testdata/large/manifest.json --results <dir>
```

See `manifest.json` -> `eval_notes` for how `lang: other`, tags and negative cases are scored.
